ask.title: Ask
ask.lead: Answers in Italian or English, with every figure tied to its source.
ask.placeholder: Ask about a category in a pilot city…

starters.s1: How is the cheese market in Rome?
starters.s2: What are the best opportunities for pasta?
starters.s3: Compare chocolate in Vienna and Paris.
starters.s4: Which sources are behind the honey data for Madrid?

ask.scopeNote: Answers use only the data already in the cell sheets. Online sentiment is an exploratory signal, never a representative sample.
ask.checked: Checked: every figure matches a cited source.
ask.checkedNoFigures: Checked: this answer contains no figures.
ask.unavailableHint: No figure is shown because it did not pass the citation check.
ask.unreadable: This stored message cannot be read.

user_limit.title: You have reached your daily question limit
user_limit.body: The limit resets tomorrow. Your question is still in the text field.

global_limit.title: The platform's daily limit has been reached
global_limit.body: Answers are back tomorrow. Cell sheets and briefs remain available.

disabled.title: Automatic answers are paused
disabled.body: An administrator has temporarily switched the assistant off. Cell sheets and briefs remain available.

model_failed.title: The answer could not be composed
model_failed.body: No data was lost. Try again shortly.

bad_input.title: The question cannot be sent
bad_input.body: Write a question of at most 2000 characters.

network.title: Connection lost
network.body: The question was not sent. Check your connection and try again.

briefs.title: Briefs
briefs.lead: Entry briefs per cell: every figure with its grade, period and source.
briefs.emptyBody: A brief appears here once it is published. Meanwhile the cell sheets show all available data.
briefs.emptyBodyStaff: No brief has been generated yet. Open a cell sheet and generate the brief from the Opportunity tab.
briefs.notCurrent: You are viewing version {n}, which is not the brief's current version.
briefs.noVersionTitle: This brief has no version yet
briefs.noVersionBody: The text appears here after the first generation.
briefs.unreadableBody: The stored content does not follow the expected format, so it is not shown. Generate a new version.
briefs.emptyVersionTitle: No sentence passed the citation check
briefs.emptyVersionBody: This version contains no verified text. The cell's data remains available in the cell sheet.
briefs.dangling: Some citations have no source ({ids}). The version cannot be exported or published.

context.title: Context
context.missingHint: Missing data is not a low score: it is left out, not estimated.

review.title: Review
review.checkFailed: Citation check not passed: this version cannot be published or exported.
review.dropped: {count, plural, =0 {No sentences removed by the citation check} one {# sentence removed by the citation check} other {# sentences removed by the citation check}}
review.droppedNote: These sentences are not part of the brief and are not exported.
review.publishedAnalyst: Only an administrator can unpublish or replace a published brief.

errors.citation: A version that did not pass the citation check cannot be published.
errors.adminOnly: Only administrators can publish or unpublish a brief.
errors.notAllowed: Your role does not allow this change.
errors.versionNotFound: The version no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.generic: The status could not be updated.

generate.pendingHint: This can take up to a minute. Stay on this page.

errors.not_staff: Only analysts and administrators can generate a brief.
errors.no_cell: This cell does not exist among the pilot cities.
errors.no_facts: Insufficient data: there are no graded figures to write the brief on.
errors.disabled: Automatic generation has been paused by an administrator.
errors.global_limit: The platform's daily limit has been reached. Try again tomorrow.
errors.user_limit: You have reached your daily brief limit. Try again tomorrow.
errors.model_failed: The brief could not be written. Try again shortly.
errors.network: Connection lost. Check whether the new version is listed under Versions before trying again.

export.printHint: In the print dialog choose "Save as PDF". The sheet is always in light colours, A4.
export.recordFailed: The export could not be recorded. Try again.
export.viewer: Your role is read-only: export is not available.
export.refusedBody: This version cannot be exported because it did not pass the citation check.

refused.not_found: The brief does not exist or is not visible to your account.
refused.viewer: Your role is read-only: export is not available.
refused.check_failed: This version did not pass the citation check and cannot be exported.
refused.unreadable: The stored content of this version cannot be read and cannot be exported.

export.demoNote: Contains demonstration data, not market data.
export.footer: FASTO FTS. Grades: A measured, B model estimate, C exploratory signal. Online sentiment is not a representative sample.

notFound.title: Brief not found
notFound.body: The brief does not exist or has not been published yet.

askEval.tileHint: The ten control questions for conversational search.
askEval.title: Reference questions
askEval.lead: Ten control questions for Ask: tool called, citations verified, kind of figure cited.
askEval.runningHint: The questions run one after the other: this can take a few minutes.
askEval.cost: Each run uses ten questions of your daily limit.
askEval.emptyBody: Results are not stored: they appear here after a run and are gone when you leave the page.
askEval.rawNote: The text is shown here without citations, for diagnosis only: figures with grade and source are visible by asking the same question in Ask.

errors.refused: Only administrators can run the reference questions.
errors.failed: The run was interrupted. Try again.
